summary: Read a binary tree. For any node, add every number stored on its left branch and every number stored on its right branch, treating a missing branch as 0, then take the positive gap between those two sums. That gap is the node's tilt. Sum the per-node gaps into one tree-wide total and write it. The sum on any branch, and every tilt, stays inside the range of a 32-bit integer.
notes: The left column is this sample's input text and the right column is the text the program should print. Comparison ignores trailing newlines.
